description: The Municipality of Copertino publishes road accidents recorded by its local police during 2021. The source distinguishes accidents with injuries, fatal accidents and accidents without injuries using the labels C.F., MO and S.F. The city catalogue provides CSV and XLSX representations and links a map of accident density. These records describe observed events on a road system and can provide a historical baseline for road-safety and disruption simulations. They do not identify an accident probability for every road segment. The metadata does not state the full column schema, geolocation accuracy or whether incidents outside local-police reporting are included. Access is public and free under Creative Commons Attribution; the licence version is not stated. The annual reporting window is established, but the temporal precision of individual records remains unknown. No directly related resource is established by the source.
